content: Forge differences: GitHub uses X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256, 'sha256=' prefix). GitLab historically used a plaintext X-Gitlab-Token header and newer versions follow Standard Webhooks (webhook-id/webhook-timestamp/webhook-signature 'v1,<base64>'). Gitea sends X-Gitea-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 hex) plus X-Gitea-Event. HMAC mechanism identical; header name, encoding and signed string differ. API model differs: GitHub PR vs GitLab merge_request (iid not id, source/target_branch) vs Gitea PR (Gitea's issue-comments endpoint doubles as PR comments). Gitea lacks PR review code-comment webhooks that GitHub has. Review-vs-comment concepts diverge most: GitHub has reviews with states, GitLab has notes+approvals, Gitea has reviews modelled on GitHub.
